title: H-MO1 Motif Benchmark Constitution (preregistration lock)
objective: Freeze every value the RGR-07 charter deliberately left open — r_pair class partition, group-span template classes, composition table f, split sizes and surface codebooks, delta_min, kappa_min, legibility discrimination floor and witness agreement rule, comparator and budget policy, and the Section 12 invalidation thresholds — as a preregistration lock before any fixture exists. Separately (H0a): admit whatever H1–H6 artifacts the founder supplies, each at its provenance class; absent artifacts, nothing is admitted.

gate_opened.act: "yes open" — opens RGR-07; adopts the charter as governing law
gate_opened.scope_of_act: gate opening only; not W2 authorization of this packet

work_unit_authorization.act: "authorized" — W2 authorization of this packet as drafted

acceptance_conditions: Every value named in the objective is frozen with a stated rationale and no fixture, example, pair, model or provider call exists.
The composition table f satisfies charter Section 7: y balanced; P(y|s), P(y|r_pair), P(y|r_group) each uninformative by factorial construction.
The relation-preserving / relation-breaking conjunction is inherited from RGR-03 Section 1 by reference, not paraphrased.
F_G and F_R are defined over a byte-identical observable set O; the extractor is counted inside F_R's budget; F_R-oracle is marked diagnostic-only.
Legibility is forced-choice discrimination against wrong-model translations with a preregistered floor; no automated result may report it passed.
Support levels are MOTIF-STRUCTURAL / MOTIF-NATURAL on the evidence axis and REPRESENTATIONAL-NECESSITY on a separate axis.
Every Section 12 invalidation condition carries a numeric threshold or an explicit reason it is categorical.
H0a records, per H1–H6 result, either the admitted artifact set with digests and provenance class, or NOT_ADMITTED (researcher-reported).
No Elemental, aspect-derived, Spiralogic or alchemical label appears in any target, latent rule identifier, template class or generator taxonomy (RGR-03 Section 19 audit).
Independent adversarial review of the constitution is recorded with provenance (RGR-04 Section XXXIV pattern) or is explicitly recorded as not yet performed.
stop_conditions: Any inherited RGR-00 … RGR-06 law or frozen artifact must change.
Any repository path outside allowed_paths is required.
Any fixture, example, pair, split file, model, training run, provider call or external inference becomes necessary.
Any member conversation, member data, Sanctuary content or production read becomes necessary.
Any Elemental or aspect-derived operator must be named to proceed.
A frozen value cannot be set without inspecting benchmark performance (would be post hoc).
The founder re-numbers the gate (charter Section 0.1): rename and re-issue this packet rather than edit it in place.
